items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Lucille? ... [INTERVIEWER] No, not Lucille; the lady that wrote 'Just For A Thrill.' Lil Hardin.

ctx.x: player, I can't remember his name. I don't know. I know they had the recreation of the Hot Five out there, remember, at Disneyland some years ago and they had Louie Armstrong, before his passing, and I think Alton sat in in Baby Dodds place, and Johnny St. Cyr was there and Harvey was sitting in for Louie's wife-- what was her name?

No, not Lucille; the lady that wrote 'Just For A Thrill.' Lil Hardin. Disneyland has done much for jazz in terms of amusement centers. A lot of people pass through that make it right away over to the riverboat, the riverboat that they have out there, which is a recreation of the way the bands used to go up the Mississippi River.
